turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I’m okay, just some pain at the incision sites, but it’s manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit queasy, but not too bad. Haven’t eaten yet, though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any sore throat or difficulty breathing from the airway management?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: My throat’s a bit sore, like I’ve been shouting or something.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything from the operating room?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, everything’s a blur. One minute I was talking, next thing I know, I’m waking up here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any other issues? Like dizziness, blurred vision, or anything else unusual?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Mouth’s really dry, but that’s about it. Oh, and my back’s a bit stiff from lying flat.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That’s normal. We’ll get you some water and monitor your vitals. You’re doing well for now.
